mapper.sql: (select min(gm.group_id) from group_member gm inner join `group` g on g.id = gm.group_id where gm.user_id = u.id and g.admin_id = #{adminId}) as group_id
(select g2.name from group_member gm inner join `group` g2 on g2.id = gm.group_id where gm.user_id = u.id and g2.admin_id = #{adminId} order by gm.group_id asc limit 1) as group_name
mapper.select: select u.*, , from normal_user u where u.admin_id = #{adminId} order by u.id desc
